test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 16 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). T sits to the immediate right of V. S sits second to the right of Q. U is an immediate neighbour of both V and S. P sits second to the left of U. Who is sitting to the immediate left of R?
solution:
Given:

P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

 T sits to the immediate right of V. U is an immediate neighbour of both V and S.

P sits second to the left of U. 

S sits second to the right of Q. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b5559039072a64a5c89ac225651e96578ed22e9b3e702120b3e209e3f289e65.png] 

Thus, 'T' is sitting to the immediate left of R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
